dict.string: Seren uses your microphone for voice input, meeting transcripts, and optional workflow recording narration.
Seren uses your camera only when you enable the camera overlay for workflow recording.
Seren captures meeting audio to produce live transcripts and notes.
Seren needs access to your Desktop folder so agents can read and write files in working directories there.
Seren needs access to your Documents folder so agents can read and write files in working directories there.
Seren needs access to your Downloads folder so agents can read and write files in working directories there.
